about: Prompt-injection test set for the AI wording layer (src/server/ai). 'payloads' are hostile text placed where a district name goes in the facts (the only free text that reaches a model; today it is set in the database, not by users). 'replies' are what a model might send back if it obeyed; 'expect' is the guard's verdict. Entries marked 'limitation' are accepted on purpose: no number/link/credential check can catch them, and they are listed so the limit is visible. Used by tests/ai-guard.test.ts and scripts/check-ai.mjs.
